bar1_yin_vs_pyin.bar: F0 corr >= 0.99 on voiced frames; gross error (>20%) <= 2%, mix AND vocal stem
bar1_yin_vs_pyin.verdict: FAIL (mix leg passes, stem leg fails)

diagnosis.note: Where both agree voiced, F0 agrees exactly (median rel err 0.00%). The stem failure is a voicing-decision/Viterbi calibration gap (C calls 1825 frames voiced vs librosa 7493), not an estimator error on matched frames.

bar1_yin_vs_pyin.prior_claim_not_reproduced: README 'Bugs found' claimed raw YIN vs librosa corr 1.0000 / 0.9997; independent re-measurement with the documented method gives 0.9919 (mix) / 0.9495 (stem) on librosa-voiced frames. README corrected.

bar2_boundaries_starred.bar: >=80% of sung-span boundaries (starts AND ends, scored separately) within +/-0.5 s of the 12 reference segments
bar2_boundaries_starred.ref_caveat: Ref segments 11-12 (143.88-152.50, 155.21-159.53) sit in the confirmed-wordless outro (last lyric word 128.20 s) - Demucs-stem RMS bleed, not singing. A perfect voicing gate tops out at 20/24 on this ref; measured 8/24 (mix) and 14/24 (stem) are far below that ceiling, so the failure is real, not a ref artifact.
bar2_boundaries_starred.prior_claim_not_reproduced: Revive-detector beat file claimed stem best 15/24; independent 150-combo sweep tops at 14/24.

bar3_beat_hpss_starred.bar: Vocal-activity boundaries must beat HPSS 12.5% starts / 8.3% ends (same segment list)

bar4_cpp_hnr_separation.bar: Median CPP sung >= instrumental + 3 dB; same direction for HNR (mix curve, sung = ref segments)

joint_signal.note: Marginals do not separate at all; the gate's joint conjunction carries only a weak 1.9x voiced-fraction signal, and pyin_voiced is INVERTED (higher on instrumental frames). CPP is inert on this mix (0.5 dB separates nothing).
